# ThaiMusicXML

> ThaiMusicXML is an open digital notation standard for Thai Traditional Music.

ThaiMusicXML documentation is available in English (`/en/`) and Thai (`/th/`). Content below links to the English version; swap `/en/` for `/th/` in any URL for the Thai translation.

## Docs

- [About](https://thaimusicxml.anan.ovh/en/about/): Background and goals of the ThaiMusicXML project
- [v1.0 Introduction](https://thaimusicxml.anan.ovh/en/v1_0/): Getting started with ThaiMusicXML v1.0

Check out [Sitemap](https://thaimusicxml.anan.ovh/sitemap-index.xml) for more details.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Nopparuj-an/ThaiMusicXML): Source code, issues, and edit history
